title: The regulatory journey
subtitle: Testing, approval, deployment and in-use oversight, and where the law changes hands
lead: Nine stages take an automated driving system from safety engineering to incident response. The function column marks whether a stage answers a type-approval question or an operational one. The break between stage 5 and stage 6 is the Second Gate: technical approval ends there and a separate legal permission to operate begins.

stages.actors: Manufacturer and automated driving system developer
stages.question: Safety architecture, safety of the intended functionality, cybersecurity, data governance
Scenario coverage, credibility of simulation, controlled validation

stages.instruments: Slovakia § 49; UK trialling framework; Croatian service testing
stages.question: Permit, operational design domain, route, safety operator, incident plan
stages.why: National law governs access to roads

stages.instruments: UN ADS Regulation; ADS GTR; Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 with JRC guidance
stages.question: Audit, safety case, track, simulation and real-world evidence
Approval of the vehicle and system against technical rules
stages.why: Type approval is not permission to run a road service

stages.instruments: UK Automated Vehicles Act; German StVG and AFGBV; French STRA; the Croatian framework. In Slovakia the only non-test deployment gate today is the § 52 operational permit for automated delivery vehicles, with a general regime still in the print 1329 reform
stages.question: Operating area, operator, remote support, service conditions

stages.instruments: Automated passenger service rules; road transport law; insurance; consumer and accessibility rules
stages.question: Service licence, insurance, accessibility, marketing

stages.instruments: Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 in-service monitoring; UN R155 and R156; NHTSA standing general order
stages.question: Occurrence reporting, software updates, maintenance, performance

stages.instruments: Event data recording; eCall; incident reporting; market surveillance
stages.actors: Police; emergency services; investigators; approval authority
stages.question: Investigation, data access, recall or withdrawal, lessons learned

source.workbook: ROAT Regulatory Map 2026 – Reconstructed Draft v0.7.1 (PraF UK), sheet "Regulatory Journey v0.3"
source.note: Conceptual bridge between type approval and road or service operation. Module 02 codes what actually stands at the operational gate in eight regimes.
